hook: One Simple Way To Maintain Your Balance And Prevent Dizziness!
claim: Claritox Pro is a capsule supplement sold to support the brain and the balance system and to 'prevent dizziness'. The sales letter is written by a 67-year-old creator who says he researched plants for a decade before making the formula.
story: Dizziness has many causes, including inner-ear problems such as BPPV, low blood pressure, dehydration, anemia, medication side effects and heart rhythm problems, and most need a medical diagnosis rather than a supplement.
ing_note: The Claritox Pro sales page and website do not list the ingredients anywhere in text. That makes it impossible to judge the formula, check doses or rule out interactions before buying. Ask the seller for the supplement facts label before ordering.
use: The website does not state the daily dose in text; follow the instructions on the bottle.
checks: No ingredient list is published, so the 'balance' claims can't be checked against any research.
No study of Claritox Pro is cited.
'Prevent dizziness' is a medical claim; recurrent dizziness should be assessed by a doctor because some causes are serious.
The page uses 'limited stock' urgency to push 3- and 6-bottle orders.
pros: Straightforward one-time prices from $49 per bottle
Free US shipping on all packages
cons: No evidence that it helps dizziness
Pressure-sales tactics ('we will run out of stock soon')
Only sold on its own website
verdict: We can't recommend a product that won't tell you what's in it, especially one aimed at dizziness, a symptom that often needs a medical diagnosis. If dizziness or balance problems are new or getting worse, see a doctor first. If you still want to try Claritox Pro, request the label and use the 60-day guarantee if it doesn't help.
